cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your lift has earned approval. You may have Saturday off; I'll cover your shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A whole weekend for you is authorized, then. I won't have you doing more for me than I do for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I still drive you Sunday? I've swapped my shift to take you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your holiday is approved instead. I'll cancel my flight and cover it. You may take the longer break; I intend to make this even in my favour.

reason: Rereading found keep Sunday ambiguous between retaining work and retaining the airport favor. Name the proposed driving and shift swap so A trip-cancellation response has one clear cause.
